verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents a column-based upsert format for writing documents (vectors plus attributes) in batches, which covers the bulk-import half of the story. No documented bulk-export to a file or format appears; server-side namespace copies and offset pagination move or read data inside turbopuffer and do not count as export. missing for 10: documented bulk-export capability and export formats, explicit bulk-import size/throughput limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import and bulk-export vectors plus metadata in documented formats

citations.quote: Upserts documents in a column-based format. This field is an object, where each key is the name of a column
